arguments.description: Explore STARAgent usage and runtime integration
arguments.prompt:
You are exploring a Python/TypeScript mixed repo. Goal: Briefly explain how STARAgent is used and integrated with the runtime. Steps:
1) Find definitions of classes or symbols named exactly or similarly to STARAgent (case variations, snake_case, filenames). Search for: STARAgent, StarAgent, star_agent, star-agent, "STAR Agent".
2) List all files where it is defined and where it is referenced (imports, instantiations, registrations, configurations).
3) Identify the runtime layer(s) in this repo (look for modules named runtime, engine, orchestrator, agent manager). Determine how STARAgent plugs into that runtime: registration hooks, factory enums, entrypoints, configuration.
4) Extract key code snippets with file:line ranges for: class definition, registration with runtime, construction/invocation, message handling methods, any specialized capabilities or tools registration.
5) Summarize concisely: a) what STARAgent is in this repo, b) how it is wired into the runtime (init path, routing), c) where it is used (entrypoints or tests), d) any config flags/env vars to enable it, e) known limitations or TODOs in comments.
Be thorough in searching across the entire repo. Prefer ripgrep-like searches and globbing. Return a clear, structured answer with code references in file_path:line_number format.

5) Concise summary answers to requested questions

a) What STARAgent is in this repo
- STARAgent is the main See-Think-Act-Reflect (STAR) agent implementation used across the codebase. It is implemented as a composition-based class 
  at /Users/lam/Desktop/repos/opendxa/dana_agent/dana/core/agent/star_agent.py and extends BaseSTARAgent. It orchestrates the STAR loop, maintains a Timeline, optional LTMemory, manages sub-agents/resources/workflows, and delegates prompt building, LLM calls, response parsing and tool execution to a pluggable AgentRuntime abstraction.

b) How it is wired into the runtime (init path, routing)
- STARAgent accepts either:
  - a ready AgentRuntime instance via runtime=..., or
  - runtime selection via codec/model/provider parameters (the constructor chooses the proper runtime).
- Selection logic:
  - If runtime is None and codec == _CODEC_SENTINEL (default), STARAgent calls RuntimeRegistry.select_runtime(provider=llm_provider, model=model) to instantiate the appropriate runtime (selector and registrations in: /Users/lam/Desktop/repos/opendxa/dana_agent/dana/core/runtime/selector.py).
  - If codec is provided (codec-based flow), STARAgent uses select_codec_runtime to instantiate a codec-aware runtime.
  - Explicit runtime objects passed in are used directly.
- Runtime contract:
  - STARAgent calls runtime.build_prompt(agent, timeline) to create LLM messages, then runtime.call_llm(...) / call_llm_async(...), runtime.parse_response(...), runtime.validate_done_output(...), and runtime.execute_tools(...) / execute_tools_async(...). The runtime implementations (AnthropicRuntime/OpenAIRuntime/Codec/Default) implement these hooks.

c) Where it is used (entrypoints or tests)
- Used everywhere agents are created in examples, app code, and tests:
  - Examples & demos (README, dana_lang examples, examples/agents/*)
  - App-level agent DanaAgent: /Users/lam/Desktop/repos/opendxa/dana_agent/dana/apps/dana/dana_agent.py
  - Tests: unit, integration, live, stress tests under /Users/lam/Desktop/repos/opendxa/dana_agent/tests/...
  - Skills subsystem (skill fork subagents), REPL, and many example agents inherit STARAgent.

d) Config flags / constructor params / env variables to enable or configure behavior
- STARAgent constructor flags (key ones):
  - runtime: AgentRuntime | None — pass runtime instance to take complete control
  - codec: type[AbstractCodec] | None | sentinel — deprecated path to select codec runtime or legacy runtime
  - llm_provider: str — provider string (e.g., "anthropic", "openai"); default chosen via config_manager.get_first_available_provider()
  - model: str — model name
  - enable_skills: bool (default True) — whether to attach ClaudeCode/skills resource
  - enable_web_search: bool — attach SimpleWebSearch resource
  - enable_code_execution: bool — attach CodeExecutionResource
  - enable_assistant: bool — create an AssistantAgent subagent
  - ltmemory_path: str — enables LTMemory persistence
  - auto_register / registry — registration behavior in base agent
- Runtime selection uses configuration via config_manager (see star_agent.py:114-116); the RuntimeRegistry selection uses provider/model strings and registered rules.
- Environment variables:
  - AgentRuntime._get_runtime_context uses os.environ.get("USER") / USERNAME to inject a user field into runtime context (base.py:516-517).
  - LLM provider credentials are handled by the LLM layer (dana.common.llm.LLM) — those typically rely on provider-specific env vars / configuration (noted indirectly in tests and docs); STARAgent itself does not define provider API env var names directly.

e) Known limitations or TODOs in comments
- codec parameter is deprecated; the code warns about codec=None mapping to LegacyRuntime (star_agent.py:131-170 warns about deprecation).
- There are explicit TODOs and known issues in specs/docs:
  - tasks/prd-star-agent-v2.md indicates planned redesign to be async-first and reduce the STARAgent "God Object" responsibilities.
  - Spec files mention gaps/limitations for Claude Skills integration — STARAgent uses enable_skills and skill resources but there are feature notes (see /Users/lam/Desktop/repos/opendxa/dana_agent/dana/specs/claude-skills-prd.md).
  - _act() has a TODO comment: "TODO: this is a good place to send interactive feedback to the user before making tool calls" — /Users/lam/Desktop/repos/opendxa/dana_agent/dana/core/agent/star_agent.py:835-838
  - STARAgent’s retry/format-correction loop for invalid JSON output is present and has limitations when LLM output deviates; referenced by specs (agent-runtime-prd.md and code).
  - Some parts of the codebase flag future rework (STARAgentv2) to address duplication of sync/async paths and constructor complexity (see tasks/prd-star-agent-v2.md).

   456	    def __getattr__(self, name: str):
   457	        """
   458	        Magic function: Convert unknown method calls to natural language and call converse.
   459	
   460	        Examples:
   461	            agent.hi_how_are_you() -> converse("hi how are you")
   462	            agent.research_coffee_companies() -> converse("research coffee companies")
   463	            agent.find_exporters_in_dak_lak() -> converse("find exporters in dak lak")
   464	        """
   465	
   466	        def magic_method(*args, **kwargs):
   467	            # Convert method name to natural language
   468	            # Replace underscores with spaces and clean up
   469	            natural_language = name.replace("_", " ").strip()
   470	
   471	            # Add any positional arguments as additional context
   472	            if args:
   473	                args_str = " ".join(str(arg) for arg in args)
   474	                natural_language += f" {args_str}"
   475	
   476	            # Add any keyword arguments as additional context
   477	            if kwargs:
   478	                kwargs_str = " ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in kwargs.items())
   479	                natural_language += f" {kwargs_str}"
   480	
   481	            # Call converse with the natural language message (starts interactive conversation)
   482	            return self.converse(initial_message=natural_language)
   483	
   484	        return magic_method

   507	
   508	            summary_response = self.llm_client.chat_response_sync(
   509	                [LLMMessage(role="user", content=compression_prompt)],
   510	                agent_id=self.object_id,

   577	
   578	        if not content:
   579	            return ""
   580	
   581	        try:
   582	            parsed = json.loads(content)
   583	            if isinstance(parsed, dict) and "summary" in parsed:
   584	                return parsed["summary"]
   585	        except json.JSONDecodeError:
   586	            pass
   587	
   588	        # Fallback: return raw content if not valid JSON
   589	        return content

   595	    @observable
   596	    def _see(self, trace_inputs: DictParams) -> DictParams:
   597	        """
   598	        SEE: See the user/caller inputs and produce percepts.
   599	
   600	        Args:
   601	            trace_inputs (DictParams): any new user/agent inputs, plus trace_outputs from the previous loop (if any)
   602	              - caller_message (str): Caller message (may be user or another agent)
   603	              - caller_type (str): Type of caller (agent or human)
   604	              - caller_id (str): ID of the caller (agent.object_id or user) for conversation tracking.
   605	              - response (str): Response from the previous loop (if any)
   606	              - tool_calls (list[DictParams]): Tool calls from the previous loop (if any)
   607	              - tool_results (list[DictParams]): Tool results from the previous loop (if any)
   608	
   609	        Returns:
   610	            - trace_percepts (DictParams): the percepts produced by this SEE phase.
   611	              - timeline (Timeline): Timeline of the agent, appending any new entries from our perceptions
   612	              - caller_message (str): Caller message (may be user or another agent)
   613	              - caller_type (str): Type of caller (agent or human)
   614	              - caller_id (str): ID of the caller (agent.object_id or user) for conversation tracking.
   615	        """
   616	
   617	        # Increment STAR loop counter at the start of each iteration
   618	        self._star_loop_count += 1
   619	
   620	        # Input parameter checking
   621	        trace_inputs = trace_inputs or {}
   622	        if self._do_exit_star_loop(trace_inputs):
   623	            return {"trace_percepts": self._mark_star_loop_exit(trace_inputs)}
   624	
   625	        previous_tool_calls: list[DictParams] = trace_inputs.get("tool_calls", None)
   626	        if previous_tool_calls:
   627	            # This is a subsequent loop - perceiving tool results
   628	            tool_results = trace_inputs.get("tool_results", [])
   629	            num_results = len(tool_results) if isinstance(tool_results, list) else 0
   630	
   631	            # Add perception message for notification visibility
   632	            trace_inputs["perception"] = f"Perceived {num_results} tool result(s)"
   633	
   634	            del trace_inputs["response"]
   635	            del trace_inputs["tool_calls"]
   636	            del trace_inputs["tool_results"]
   637	        else:
   638	            # This is the first loop
   639	            caller_message: str = trace_inputs.get("caller_message", trace_inputs.get("message", None))
   640	            if not caller_message:
   641	                return {"trace_percepts": self._mark_star_loop_exit(trace_inputs)}
   642	
   643	            # Add caller_message to timeline with caller tracking
   644	            if isinstance(caller_message, str):
   645	                # Create new entry and mark it as latest
   646	                new_entry = TimelineEntry(entry_type=TimelineEntryType.USER_MESSAGE, content=caller_message, is_latest_user_message=True)
   647	                self._timeline.add_entry(new_entry)
   648	
   649	            # Preserve caller_message for notifications but remove original keys
   650	            trace_inputs.pop("message", None)  # Remove 'message' alias
   651	            # Keep caller_message in trace_inputs for notification
   652	            if "caller_message" not in trace_inputs:
   653	                trace_inputs["caller_message"] = caller_message
   654	
   655	        trace_inputs |= {"timeline": self._timeline}
   656	
   657	        return super()._see(trace_inputs)

   659	    def _format_tool_call_as_xml(self, tool_call: DictParams) -> str:
   660	        """Format a tool call dict as XML for consistent LLM context.
   661	
   662	        This ensures the LLM sees tool calls in the same XML format it should
   663	        produce, rather than Python dict format which it might mimic.
   664	        """
   665	        func = tool_call.get("function", "unknown:unknown")
   666	        args = tool_call.get("arguments", {})
   667	
   668	        # Build XML parameters
   669	        params_xml = ""
   670	        for key, value in args.items():
   671	            params_xml += f'<parameter name="{key}">{value}</parameter>'
   672	
   673	        return f'<function_call><invoke name="{func}">{params_xml}</invoke></function_call>'

   677	        """
   678	        THINK: Think about the percepts and produce thoughts. This is where we make an LLM call.
   679	
   680	        Args:
   681	            trace_percepts (DictParams): the percepts produced by this SEE phase.
   682	              - timeline (Timeline): Timeline of the agent.
   683	
   684	        Returns:
   685	            - trace_thoughts (DictParams): the thoughts produced by this THINK phase.
   686	              - response (str): Response from the LLM
   687	              - tool_calls (list[DictParams]): Tool calls from the LLM
   688	        """
   689	
   690	        # Input parameter checking
   691	        trace_percepts = trace_percepts or {}
   692	        if self._do_exit_star_loop(trace_percepts) or not trace_percepts:
   693	            return {"trace_thoughts": self._mark_star_loop_exit(trace_percepts)}
   694	
   695	        timeline: Timeline = trace_percepts.get("timeline", self._timeline)
   696	        trace_percepts.pop("timeline", None)
   697

   699	        self._maybe_compress_timeline(timeline)

   703	
   704	        response, reasoning, tool_calls, done, todo_list = None, None, [], None, None
   705	        output_state = "retry"
   706	        for attempt in range(self.MAX_THINK_RETRIES):
   707	            raw = self._runtime.call_llm(llm_messages)
   708	            parsed = self._runtime.parse_response(raw)
   709	            response, reasoning, tool_calls, done, todo_list = (
   710	                parsed.response,
   711	                parsed.reasoning,
   712	                parsed.tool_calls,
   713	                parsed.done,
   714	                parsed.todo_list,
   715	            )
   716	
   717	            has_tool_calls = bool(tool_calls)
   718	            has_response = bool(response and response.strip())
   719	            output_state = self._runtime.validate_done_output(done, has_tool_calls, has_response)
   720	
   721	            if output_state != "retry":
   722	                break
   723	
   724	            if attempt < self.MAX_THINK_RETRIES - 1:
   725	                llm_messages.append(self._runtime.build_output_format_correction())
   726	                logger.warning(
   727	                    "Invalid output format, retrying",
   728	                    attempt=attempt + 1,
   729	                    done=done,
   730	                    has_tool_calls=has_tool_calls,
   731	                    has_response=has_response,
   732	                )
   733	
   734	        if output_state == "retry":
   735	            response = "No response generated"
   736	            tool_calls = []
   737	            done = True
   738	            output_state = "exit"
   739	
   740	        if not tool_calls or len(tool_calls) == 0:
   741	            response = response if (response and len(response) > 0) else "No response generated"
   742	            timeline.add_entry(
   743	                TimelineEntry(
   744	                    entry_type=TimelineEntryType.AGENT_RESPONSE,
   745	                    content=response,
   746	                )
   747	            )
   748	        else:
   749	            if reasoning and len(reasoning) > 0:
   750	                timeline.add_entry(
   751	                    TimelineEntry(
   752	                        entry_type=TimelineEntryType.AGENT_THOUGHTS,
   753	                        content=reasoning,
   754	                    )
   755	                )
   756	
   757	            if response and len(response) > 0:
   758	                timeline.add_entry(
   759	                    TimelineEntry(
   760	                        entry_type=TimelineEntryType.AGENT_THOUGHTS,
   761	                        content=response,
   762	                    )
   763	                )
   764	
   765	            # Add todo_list BEFORE tool calls so it doesn't break the tool_call → tool_result sequence
   766	            # (OpenAI requires tool results immediately after tool calls)
   767	            if todo_list:
   768	                in_progress = [t for t in todo_list if t.status == "in_progress"]
   769	                pending = [t for t in todo_list if t.status == "pending"]
   770	                completed = [t for t in todo_list if t.status == "completed"]
   771	                logger.info(
   772	                    "Todo list updated",
   773	                    in_progress=len(in_progress),
   774	                    pending=len(pending),
   775	                    completed=len(completed),
   776	                )
   777	                # Format todo_list for timeline
   778	                todo_lines = []
   779	                for item in todo_list:
   780	                    status_marker = {"in_progress": "[IN PROGRESS]", "pending": "[PENDING]", "completed": "[COMPLETED]"}.get(
   781	                        item.status, "[?]"
   782	                    )
   783	                    todo_lines.append(f"{status_marker} {item.content}")
   784	                # Remove any existing TODO_LIST entries to avoid accumulation
   785	                timeline.timeline = [e for e in timeline.timeline if e.entry_type != TimelineEntryType.TODO_LIST]
   786	                timeline.add_entry(
   787	                    TimelineEntry(
   788	                        entry_type=TimelineEntryType.TODO_LIST,
   789	                        content="\n".join(todo_lines),
   790	                    )
   791	                )
   792	
   793	            # Check if these are native tool calls (have tool_call_id)
   794	            has_native_tool_calls = any(tc.get("tool_call_id") for tc in tool_calls)
   795	
   796	            if has_native_tool_calls:
   797	                # For native OpenAI tools, store all tool_calls in a single entry
   798	                # The tool_calls will be converted to proper OpenAI format when building messages
   799	                timeline.add_entry(
   800	                    TimelineEntry(
   801	                        entry_type=TimelineEntryType.TOOL_CALL,
   802	                        content="",  # Content is empty for native tool calls
   803	                        tool_calls=tool_calls,  # Store native tool_calls array
   804	                    )
   805	                )
   806	            else:
   807	                # Legacy XML format - store each tool call separately
   808	                for tool_call in tool_calls:
   809	                    timeline.add_entry(
   810	                        TimelineEntry(
   811	                            entry_type=TimelineEntryType.TOOL_CALL,
   812	                            content=self._format_tool_call_as_xml(tool_call),
   813	                        )
   814	                    )

   816	        # Output parameter checking
   817	        response = response or ""
   818	        assert isinstance(response, str)
   819	        assert isinstance(tool_calls, list)
   820	        trace_percepts |= {
   821	            "response": response,
   822	            "reasoning": reasoning,
   823	            "tool_calls": tool_calls,
   824	            "done": done,
   825	            "todo_list": todo_list,
   826	        }
   827	
   828	        if output_state == "exit":
   829	            trace_percepts = self._mark_star_loop_exit(trace_percepts)
   830	
   831	        return super()._think(trace_percepts)

   833	    @observable
   834	    def _act(self, trace_thoughts: DictParams) -> DictParams:
   835	        """
   836	        ACT: Execute tool calls and return results.
   837	        TODO: this is a good place to send interactive feedback to the user before making tool calls
   838	
   839	        Args:
   840	            trace_thoughts (DictParams): the thoughts produced by this THINK phase.
   841	              - response (str): Response from the LLM from the THINK phase.
   842	              - tool_calls (list[DictParams]): Tool calls from the THINK phase.
   843	              - caller_message (str): Caller message (may be user or another agent)
   844	              - caller_type (str): Type of caller (agent or human)
   845	              - caller_id (str): ID of the caller (agent.object_id or user) for conversation tracking.
   846	
   847	        Returns:
   848	            - trace_outputs (DictParams): the outputs produced by this ACT phase.
   849	              - response (str): Response from the LLM from the THINK phase.
   850	              - tool_calls (list[DictParams]): Tool calls from the THINK phase.
   851	              - tool_results: list[DictParams]: Tool results from the ACT phase if there are tool calls
   852	              - caller_message (str): Caller message (may be user or another agent)
   853	              - caller_type (str): Type of caller (agent or human)
   854	              - caller_id (str): ID of the caller (agent.object_id or user) for conversation tracking.
   855	        """
   856	
   857	        # Input parameter checking
   858	        trace_thoughts = trace_thoughts or {}
   859	        if not trace_thoughts or self._do_exit_star_loop(trace_thoughts):
   860	            return {"trace_outputs": self._mark_star_loop_exit(trace_thoughts)}
   861	
   862	        tool_calls: list[DictParams] = trace_thoughts.get("tool_calls")
   863	
   864	        # Execute tool calls using runtime
   865	        tool_results = self._runtime.execute_tools(self, tool_calls)
   866	
   867	        # Add tool results to timeline
   868	        if isinstance(tool_results, list):
   869	            for tool_result in tool_results:
   870	                if isinstance(tool_result, dict):
   871	                    # Determine entry type based on tool type
   872	                    tool_type = tool_result.get("type")
   873	                    if tool_type == "agent":
   874	                        entry_type = TimelineEntryType.SUB_AGENT_RESPONSE
   875	                    elif tool_type == "resource":
   876	                        entry_type = TimelineEntryType.RESOURCE_RESULT
   877	                    elif tool_type == "workflow":
   878	                        entry_type = TimelineEntryType.WORKFLOW_RESULT
   879	                    else:  # unknown
   880	                        entry_type = TimelineEntryType.UNKNOWN_TOOL_CALL
   881	
   882	                    # Ensure content is a string (tool results may be dicts)
   883	                    result_content = tool_result.get("result", "Unknown tool result")
   884	                    if not isinstance(result_content, str):
   885	                        import json
   886	
   887	                        result_content = json.dumps(result_content)
   888	
   889	                    # Include tool_call_id for OpenAI native tool support
   890	                    self._timeline.add_entry(
   891	                        TimelineEntry(
   892	                            entry_type=entry_type,
   893	                            content=result_content,
   894	                            tool_call_id=tool_result.get("tool_call_id"),
   895	                        )
   896	                    )
   897	
   898	            # Add a system reminder to continue if task is not complete
   899	            # Find original user request
   900	            original_request = ""
   901	            for entry in self._timeline.timeline:
   902	                if entry.entry_type == TimelineEntryType.USER_MESSAGE:
   903	                    original_request = entry.content
   904	                    break
   905	
   906	            # Count completed tool calls to estimate progress
   907	            tool_call_count = sum(1 for entry in self._timeline.timeline if entry.entry_type == TimelineEntryType.TOOL_CALL)
   908	
   909	            # Estimate expected steps based on sequential action patterns
   910	            # "search then fetch" = 2 steps, "search, then process, then save" = 3 steps
   911	            request_lower = original_request.lower()
   912	            # Count occurrences of step separators (avoiding overlap)
   913	            import re
   914	
   915	            step_separators = re.findall(r"\bthen\b|\bafter that\b|\bnext\b|\bfinally\b", request_lower)
   916	            expected_steps = 1 + len(step_separators)
   917	            # Cap expected_steps at a reasonable maximum
   918	            expected_steps = min(expected_steps, 5)
   919	
   920	            # Only add reminder if we haven't completed all expected steps
   921	            if tool_call_count < expected_steps:
   922	                remaining = expected_steps - tool_call_count
   923	                self._timeline.add_entry(
   924	                    TimelineEntry(
   925	                        entry_type=TimelineEntryType.AGENT_THOUGHTS,
   926	                        content=f"[MULTI-STEP TASK - {remaining} STEP(S) REMAINING] "
   927	                        f"Completed {tool_call_count}/{expected_steps} steps. "
   928	                        "I MUST call the next tool using this EXACT XML format: "
   929	                        '<function_call><invoke name="resource-id:method"><parameter name="param">value</parameter></invoke></function_call>',
   930	                    )
   931	                )
   932	
   933	        # Output parameter checking
   934	        assert isinstance(tool_results, list)
   935	        trace_thoughts |= {"tool_results": tool_results}
   936	
   937	        return super()._act(trace_thoughts)

   940	    def _reflect(self, trace_outputs: DictParams) -> DictParams:
   941	        """
   942	        REFLECT: Reflect on the actions or episode, depending on the reflection phase.
   943	
   944	        Args:
   945	            trace_outputs (DictParams): the outputs produced by this ACT phase.
   946	              - phase (LearningPhase): specifies which learning phase we are in
   947	              - response (str): Response from the THINK phase.

   957

   960	        if not trace_outputs or self._do_exit_star_loop(trace_outputs):

   962	        phase: LearningPhase = trace_outputs.get("phase") or LearningPhase.ACQUISITIVE
   963	
   964	        trace_learning = {}
   965	        if self._learner is not None:
   966	            match phase:
   967	                case LearningPhase.ACQUISITIVE:
   968	                    trace_learning |= self._learner._reflect_acquisitive(trace_outputs)
   969	                    trace_learning["learning_note"] = "Initial learning and trial-level plasticity"
   970	
   971	                case LearningPhase.EPISODIC:
   972	                    trace_learning |= self._learner._reflect_episodic(trace_outputs)
   973	                    trace_learning["learning_note"] = "Episodic binding of information"
   974	
   975	                case LearningPhase.INTEGRATIVE:
   976	                    trace_learning |= self._learner._reflect_integrative(trace_outputs)
   977	                    trace_learning["learning_note"] = "Offline replay and integration"
   978	
   979	                case LearningPhase.RETENTIVE:
   980	                    trace_learning |= self._learner._reflect_retentive(trace_outputs)
   981	                    trace_learning["learning_note"] = "Long-term maintenance and habit formation"
   982	
   983	                case _:
   984	                    raise ValueError(f"Unknown learning phase {phase}")
   985	
   986	            trace_learning |= {
   987	                "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
   988	                "phase": phase.value,
   989	            }
   990	
   991	            # Add to timeline for persistence
   992	            self._timeline.add_entry(
   993	                TimelineEntry(
   994	                    entry_type=TimelineEntryType.AGENT_LEARNING,
   995	                    content=f"Learning ({phase.value}): {trace_learning.get('learning_note', 'No learning note')}",
   996	                )
   997	            )

   999	        return super()._reflect(trace_learning)

   682	    def _extract_json(self, content: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
   683	        """Extract JSON object from content."""
   684	        if not content:
   685	            return None
   686	
   687	        try:
   688	            return json.loads(content.strip())
   689	        except json.JSONDecodeError:
   690	            pass
   691	
   692	        # Try markdown code block
   693	        json_match = re.search(r"```(?:json)?\s*(\{.+\})\s*```", content, re.DOTALL)
   694	        if json_match:
   695	            try:
   696	                return json.loads(json_match.group(1))
   697	            except json.JSONDecodeError:
   698	                pass
   699	
   700	        # Try balanced brace matching
   701	        start_idx = content.find('{"done"')
   702	        if start_idx == -1:
   703	            start_idx = content.find("{\n")
   704	        if start_idx == -1:
   705	            start_idx = content.find("{")
   706	
   707	        if start_idx != -1:
   708	            depth = 0
   709	            for i, char in enumerate(content[start_idx:], start_idx):
   710	                if char == "{":
   711	                    depth += 1
   712	                elif char == "}":
   713	                    depth -= 1
   714	                    if depth == 0:
   715	                        try:
   716	                            return json.loads(content[start_idx : i + 1])
   717	                        except json.JSONDecodeError:
   718	                            pass
   719	                        break
   720	
   721	        return None
   722	
   723	    def _extract_trailing_text(self, content: str) -> str | None:
   724	        """Extract text that comes after a JSON object.
   725	
   726	        Handles cases like: '{"done":true} Here is the actual response...'
   727	        Returns the trailing text after the JSON object, or None if no trailing text.
   728	        """
   729	        if not content:
   730	            return None
   731	
   732	        # Find the JSON object boundaries
   733	        start_idx = content.find("{")
   734	        if start_idx == -1:
   735	            return None
   736	
   737	        depth = 0
   738	        end_idx = -1
   739	        for i, char in enumerate(content[start_idx:], start_idx):
   740	            if char == "{":
   741	                depth += 1
   742	            elif char == "}":
   743	                depth -= 1
   744	                if depth == 0:
   745	                    end_idx = i
   746	                    break
   747	
   748	        if end_idx == -1:
   749	            return None
   750	
   751	        # Extract text after the JSON object
   752	        trailing = content[end_idx + 1 :].strip()
   753	        if trailing:
   754	            return trailing
   755	
   756	        return None

   758	    def _extract_content_between_xml_tags(self, content: str, tag: str) -> str | None:
   759	        if not content or not tag:
   760	            return None
   761	
   762	        escaped_tag = re.escape(tag)
   763	        match = re.search(r"<" + escaped_tag + r">(.*?)</" + escaped_tag + r">", content, re.DOTALL)
   764	        if match:
   765	            return match.group(1).strip()
   766	
   767	        match = re.search(r"<" + escaped_tag + r">([^<]*)", content, re.DOTALL)
   768	        if match:
   769	            captured = match.group(1).strip()
   770	            if not captured:
   771	                match = re.search(r"<" + escaped_tag + r">(.*)", content, re.DOTALL)
   772	                if match:
   773	                    return match.group(1).strip()
   774	            return captured
   775	
   776	        return None

   854	    def _validate_n_cast_method_arguments(self, method, arguments: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
   855	        import types
   856	        from typing import Union, get_origin
   857	
   858	        try:
   859	            signature = Misc.parse_method_signature(method)
   860	        except Exception:
   861	            return arguments
   862	
   863	        for param in signature.parameters:
   864	            if param.type_object and param.name in arguments:
   865	                if param.type_object is Any:
   866	                    continue
   867	
   868	                origin = get_origin(param.type_object)
   869	                if origin is None:
   870	                    origin = param.type_object
   871	
   872	                is_union_type = hasattr(param.type_object, "__args__") and (origin is Union or origin is types.UnionType)
   873	                if is_union_type:
   874	                    hinted_types = param.type_object.__args__
   875	                else:
   876	                    hinted_types = [origin]
   877	
   878	                for hinted_type in hinted_types:
   879	                    if hinted_type is type(None):
   880	                        continue
   881	                    if hinted_type is Any:
   882	                        break
   883	
   884	                    type_origin = get_origin(hinted_type)
   885	                    if type_origin is None:
   886	                        type_origin = hinted_type
   887	
   888	                    if type_origin is not Any and isinstance(arguments[param.name], type_origin):
   889	                        break
   890	
   891	                    if type_origin in (str, int, float):
   892	                        try:
   893	                            arguments[param.name] = type_origin(arguments[param.name])
   894	                            break
   895	                        except Exception:
   896	                            continue
   897	                    elif type_origin is bool:
   898	                        val = arguments[param.name]
   899	                        if isinstance(val, bool):
   900	                            break
   901	                        if isinstance(val, str):
   902	                            arguments[param.name] = val.lower() in ("true", "1", "yes", "on")
   903	                            break
   904	                        try:
   905	                            arguments[param.name] = bool(val)
   906	                            break
   907	                        except Exception:
   908	                            continue
   909	                    elif type_origin is list:
   910	                        val = arguments[param.name]
   911	                        if isinstance(val, list):
   912	                            break
   913	                        if isinstance(val, str):
   914	                            try:
   915	                                parsed = json.loads(val)
   916	                                if isinstance(parsed, list):
   917	                                    arguments[param.name] = parsed
   918	                                    break
   919	                            except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
   920	                                continue
   921	                    elif type_origin is dict:
   922	                        val = arguments[param.name]
   923	                        if isinstance(val, dict):
   924	                            break
   925	                        if isinstance(val, str):
   926	                            try:
   927	                                parsed = json.loads(val)
   928	                                if isinstance(parsed, dict):
   929	                                    arguments[param.name] = parsed
   930	                                    break
   931	                            except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
   932	                                continue
   933	
   934	        return arguments

   936	    def _parse_function_name(self, function_name: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
   937	        """Parse function name into (identifier, method_name)."""
   938	        if ":" in function_name:

   940	        if "__" in function_name:
   941	            parts = function_name.rsplit("__", 1)
   942	            if len(parts) == 2:
   943	                return parts[0].replace("_", "-"), parts[1]

    20	class RuntimeRegistry:

    26	    custom instances for specialized scenarios.
    27	
    28	    Usage:

    30	        runtime = RuntimeRegistry.select_runtime(provider="anthropic", model="claude-3")

    64	        registry = cls()

   134	    @classmethod
   135	    def reset_default(cls) -> None:
   136	        """Reset the default registry. Useful for testing."""
   137	        cls._default = None
   138	
   139	    def register(
   140	        self,
   141	        runtime_class: type[AgentRuntime],
   142	        *,
   143	        provider: str | list[str] | None = None,
   144	        model_pattern: str | None = None,
   145	        priority: int = 0,
   146	        **default_kwargs: Any,
   147	    ) -> RuntimeRegistry:
   148	        """
   149	        Register a runtime class with matching conditions.
   150	
   151	        Args:
   152	            runtime_class: The AgentRuntime class to instantiate when conditions match.
   153	            provider: Match specific provider(s). None matches any provider.
   154	            model_pattern: Glob pattern for model names (e.g., "claude-3*", "gpt-4*").
   155	            priority: Higher priority rules are checked first. Default is 0.
   156	            **default_kwargs: Default kwargs passed to the runtime constructor.
   157	
   158	        Returns:
   159	            self, for chaining.
   160	        """
   161	        conditions = {
   162	            "provider": provider,
   163	            "model_pattern": model_pattern,
   164	            "priority": priority,
   165	        }
   166	        self._rules.append((conditions, runtime_class, default_kwargs))
   167	        # Sort by priority (higher first)
   168	        self._rules.sort(key=lambda x: -x[0].get("priority", 0))
   169	        return self

   171	    def select(
   172	        self,
   173	        model: str | None = None,
   174	        provider: str = "anthropic",
   175	        **kwargs: Any,
   176	    ) -> AgentRuntime:
   177	        """
   178	        Select and instantiate the appropriate runtime.
   179	
   180	        Args:
   181	            model: The model name (e.g., "claude-3-opus-20240229").
   182	            provider: The provider name (e.g., "anthropic", "openai").
   183	            **kwargs: Additional kwargs passed to the runtime constructor.
   184	
   185	        Returns:
   186	            An instantiated AgentRuntime.
   187	        """
   188	        for conditions, runtime_class, default_kwargs in self._rules:
   189	            if self._matches(conditions, model, provider):
   190	                merged_kwargs = {**default_kwargs, **kwargs}
   191	                return runtime_class(model=model, provider=provider, **merged_kwargs)
   192	
   193	        # Fallback to DefaultRuntime
   194	        from .default import DefaultRuntime
   195	
   196	        return DefaultRuntime(model=model, provider=provider, **kwargs)
   197	
   198	    def _matches(
   199	        self,
   200	        conditions: dict[str, Any],
   201	        model: str | None,
   202	        provider: str,
   203	    ) -> bool:
   204	        """Check if conditions match the given model and provider."""
   205	        # Check provider
   206	        cond_provider = conditions.get("provider")
   207	        if cond_provider is not None:
   208	            if isinstance(cond_provider, list):
   209	                if provider not in cond_provider:
   210	                    return False
   211	            elif provider != cond_provider:
   212	                return False
   213	
   214	        # Check model pattern
   215	        model_pattern = conditions.get("model_pattern")
   216	        if model_pattern is not None:
   217	            if model is None:
   218	                return False
   219	            if not fnmatch.fnmatch(model, model_pattern):
   220	                return False
   221	
   222	        return True

   227	        return [(conditions, runtime_class) for conditions, runtime_class, _ in self._rules]

   463	            agent.find_exporters_in_dak_lak() -> converse("find exporters in dak lak")
   464	        """
   465	
   466	        def magic_method(*args, **kwargs):
   467	            # Convert method name to natural language
   468	            # Replace underscores with spaces and clean up
   469	            natural_language = name.replace("_", " ").strip()
   470	
   471	            # Add any positional arguments as additional context
   472	            if args:
   473	                args_str = " ".join(str(arg) for arg in args)
   474	                natural_language += f" {args_str}"
   475	
   476	            # Add any keyword arguments as additional context
   477	            if kwargs:
   478	                kwargs_str = " ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in kwargs.items())
   479	                natural_language += f" {kwargs_str}"
   480	
   481	            # Call converse with the natural language message (starts interactive conversation)
   482	            return self.converse(initial_message=natural_language)
   483	
   484	        return magic_method

   493	
   494	        Uses the LLM to summarize old entries, preserving recent context.
   495	        This prevents unbounded context growth in long conversations.
   496	        """
   497	        if not timeline.needs_compression():
   498	            return
   499	
   500	        compression_prompt = timeline.build_compression_prompt()
   501	        if not compression_prompt:
   502	            return
   503	
   504	        try:
   505	            # Use a quick LLM call to summarize old entries
   506	            from dana.common.llm.types import LLMMessage
   507	
   508	            summary_response = self.llm_client.chat_response_sync(
   509	                [LLMMessage(role="user", content=compression_prompt)],
   510	                agent_id=self.object_id,
   511	                agent_type=self.agent_type,
   512	                temperature=0,
   513	            )
   514	
   515	            raw_content = summary_response.content.strip() if summary_response.content else ""
   516	
   517	            # Parse JSON response to extract summary
   518	            summary = self._extract_compression_summary(raw_content)

   520	            if summary:
   521	                compressed_count = timeline.compress_old_entries(summary)
   522	                logger.info(

   525	                    compressed_entries=compressed_count,

   527	                )
   528	        except Exception as e:
   529	            # Don't fail the main operation if compression fails
   530	            logger.warning("Timeline compression failed", error=str(e))

   567	    def _extract_compression_summary(self, content: str) -> str:
   568	        """Extract summary from JSON compression response.
   569	
   570	        Args:
   571	            content: Raw LLM response (expected JSON with 'summary' field)
   572	
   573	        Returns:
   574	            Extracted summary text, or the raw content as fallback
   575	        """
   576	        import json
   577	
   578	        if not content:
   579	            return ""
   580	
   581	        try:
   582	            parsed = json.loads(content)
   583	            if isinstance(parsed, dict) and "summary" in parsed:
   584	                return parsed["summary"]
   585	        except json.JSONDecodeError:
   586	            pass
   587	
   588	        # Fallback: return raw content if not valid JSON
   589	        return content

   595	    @observable
   596	    def _see(self, trace_inputs: DictParams) -> DictParams:
   597	        """
   598	        SEE: See the user/caller inputs and produce percepts.
   599	
   600	        Args:
   601	            trace_inputs (DictParams): any new user/agent inputs, plus trace_outputs from the previous loop (if any)
   602	              - caller_message (str): Caller message (may be user or another agent)
   603	              - caller_type (str): Type of caller (agent or human)
   604	              - caller_id (str): ID of the caller (agent.object_id or user) for conversation tracking.
   605	              - response (str): Response from the previous loop (if any)
   606	              - tool_calls (list[DictParams]): Tool calls from the previous loop (if any)
   607	              - tool_results (list[DictParams]): Tool results from the previous loop (if any)
   608	
   609	        Returns:
   610	            - trace_percepts (DictParams): the percepts produced by this SEE phase.
   611	              - timeline (Timeline): Timeline of the agent, appending any new entries from our perceptions
   612	              - caller_message (str): Caller message (may be user or another agent)
   613	              - caller_type (str): Type of caller (agent or human)
   614	              - caller_id (str): ID of the caller (agent.object_id or user) for conversation tracking.
   615	        """
   616	
   617	        # Increment STAR loop counter at the start of each iteration
   618	        self._star_loop_count += 1
   619	
   620	        # Input parameter checking
   621	        trace_inputs = trace_inputs or {}
   622	        if self._do_exit_star_loop(trace_inputs):
   623	            return {"trace_percepts": self._mark_star_loop_exit(trace_inputs)}
   624	
   625	        previous_tool_calls: list[DictParams] = trace_inputs.get("tool_calls", None)
   626	        if previous_tool_calls:
   627	            # This is a subsequent loop - perceiving tool results
   628	            tool_results = trace_inputs.get("tool_results", [])
   629	            num_results = len(tool_results) if isinstance(tool_results, list) else 0
   630	
   631	            # Add perception message for notification visibility
   632	            trace_inputs["perception"] = f"Perceived {num_results} tool result(s)"
   633	
   634	            del trace_inputs["response"]
   635	            del trace_inputs["tool_calls"]
   636	            del trace_inputs["tool_results"]
   637	        else:
   638	            # This is the first loop
   639	            caller_message: str = trace_inputs.get("caller_message", trace_inputs.get("message", None))
   640	            if not caller_message:
   641	                return {"trace_percepts": self._mark_star_loop_exit(trace_inputs)}
   642	
   643	            # Add caller_message to timeline with caller tracking
   644	            if isinstance(caller_message, str):
   645	                # Create new entry and mark it as latest
   646	                new_entry = TimelineEntry(entry_type=TimelineEntryType.USER_MESSAGE, content=caller_message, is_latest_user_message=True)
   647	                self._timeline.add_entry(new_entry)
   648	
   649	            # Preserve caller_message for notifications but remove original keys
   650	            trace_inputs.pop("message", None)  # Remove 'message' alias
   651	            # Keep caller_message in trace_inputs for notification
   652	            if "caller_message" not in trace_inputs:
   653	                trace_inputs["caller_message"] = caller_message
   654	
   655	        trace_inputs |= {"timeline": self._timeline}
   656	
   657	        return super()._see(trace_inputs)

   659	    def _format_tool_call_as_xml(self, tool_call: DictParams) -> str:
   660	        """Format a tool call dict as XML for consistent LLM context.
   661	
   662	        This ensures the LLM sees tool calls in the same XML format it should
   663	        produce, rather than Python dict format which it might mimic.
   664	        """
   665	        func = tool_call.get("function", "unknown:unknown")
   666	        args = tool_call.get("arguments", {})
   667	
   668	        # Build XML parameters
   669	        params_xml = ""
   670	        for key, value in args.items():
   671	            params_xml += f'<parameter name="{key}">{value}</parameter>'
   672	
   673	        return f'<function_call><invoke name="{func}">{params_xml}</invoke></function_call>'

   675	    @observable
   676	    def _think(self, trace_percepts: DictParams) -> DictParams:
   677	        """
   678	        THINK: Think about the percepts and produce thoughts. This is where we make an LLM call.
   679	
   680	        Args:
   681	            trace_percepts (DictParams): the percepts produced by this SEE phase.
   682	              - timeline (Timeline): Timeline of the agent.
   683	
   684	        Returns:
   685	            - trace_thoughts (DictParams): the thoughts produced by this THINK phase.
   686	              - response (str): Response from the LLM
   687	              - tool_calls (list[DictParams]): Tool calls from the LLM
   688	        """
   689	
   690	        # Input parameter checking
   691	        trace_percepts = trace_percepts or {}
   692	        if self._do_exit_star_loop(trace_percepts) or not trace_percepts:
   693	            return {"trace_thoughts": self._mark_star_loop_exit(trace_percepts)}
   694	
   695	        timeline: Timeline = trace_percepts.get("timeline", self._timeline)
   696	        trace_percepts.pop("timeline", None)
   697	
   698	        # Check if timeline needs compression before building messages
   699	        self._maybe_compress_timeline(timeline)
   700	
   701	        # Build LLM messages using runtime
   702	        llm_messages = self._runtime.build_prompt(self, timeline)
   703	
   704	        response, reasoning, tool_calls, done, todo_list = None, None, [], None, None
   705	        output_state = "retry"
   706	        for attempt in range(self.MAX_THINK_RETRIES):
   707	            raw = self._runtime.call_llm(llm_messages)
   708	            parsed = self._runtime.parse_response(raw)
   709	            response, reasoning, tool_calls, done, todo_list = (
   710	                parsed.response,
   711	                parsed.reasoning,
   712	                parsed.tool_calls,
   713	                parsed.done,
   714	                parsed.todo_list,
   715	            )
   716	
   717	            has_tool_calls = bool(tool_calls)
   718	            has_response = bool(response and response.strip())
   719	            output_state = self._runtime.validate_done_output(done, has_tool_calls, has_response)
   720	
   721	            if output_state != "retry":
   722	                break
   723	
   724	            if attempt < self.MAX_THINK_RETRIES - 1:
   725	                llm_messages.append(self._runtime.build_output_format_correction())
   726	                logger.warning(
   727	                    "Invalid output format, retrying",
   728	                    attempt=attempt + 1,
   729	                    done=done,
   730	                    has_tool_calls=has_tool_calls,
   731	                    has_response=has_response,
   732	                )
   733	
   734	        if output_state == "retry":
   735	            response = "No response generated"
   736	            tool_calls = []
   737	            done = True
   738	            output_state = "exit"
   739	
   740	        if not tool_calls or len(tool_calls) == 0:
   741	            response = response if (response and len(response) > 0) else "No response generated"
   742	            timeline.add_entry(
   743	                TimelineEntry(
   744	                    entry_type=TimelineEntryType.AGENT_RESPONSE,
   745	                    content=response,
   746	                )
   747	            )
   748	        else:
   749	            if reasoning and len(reasoning) > 0:
   750	                timeline.add_entry(
   751	                    TimelineEntry(
   752	                        entry_type=TimelineEntryType.AGENT_THOUGHTS,
   753	                        content=reasoning,
   754	                    )
   755	                )
   756	
   757	            if response and len(response) > 0:
   758	                timeline.add_entry(
   759	                    TimelineEntry(
   760	                        entry_type=TimelineEntryType.AGENT_THOUGHTS,
   761	                        content=response,
   762	                    )
   763	                )
   764	
   765	            # Add todo_list BEFORE tool calls so it doesn't break the tool_call → tool_result sequence
   766	            # (OpenAI requires tool results immediately after tool calls)
   767	            if todo_list:
   768	                in_progress = [t for t in todo_list if t.status == "in_progress"]
   769	                pending = [t for t in todo_list if t.status == "pending"]
   770	                completed = [t for t in todo_list if t.status == "completed"]
   771	                logger.info(
   772	                    "Todo list updated",
   773	                    in_progress=len(in_progress),
   774	                    pending=len(pending),
   775	                    completed=len(completed),
   776	                )
   777	                # Format todo_list for timeline
   778	                todo_lines = []
   779	                for item in todo_list:
   780	                    status_marker = {"in_progress": "[IN PROGRESS]", "pending": "[PENDING]", "completed": "[COMPLETED]"}.get(
   781	                        item.status, "[?]"
   782	                    )
   783	                    todo_lines.append(f"{status_marker} {item.content}")
   784	                # Remove any existing TODO_LIST entries to avoid accumulation
   785	                timeline.timeline = [e for e in timeline.timeline if e.entry_type != TimelineEntryType.TODO_LIST]
   786	                timeline.add_entry(
   787	                    TimelineEntry(
   788	                        entry_type=TimelineEntryType.TODO_LIST,
   789	                        content="\n".join(todo_lines),
   790	                    )
   791	                )
   792	
   793	            # Check if these are native tool calls (have tool_call_id)
   794	            has_native_tool_calls = any(tc.get("tool_call_id") for tc in tool_calls)
   795	
   796	            if has_native_tool_calls:
   797	                # For native OpenAI tools, store all tool_calls in a single entry
   798	                # The tool_calls will be converted to proper OpenAI format when building messages
   799	                timeline.add_entry(
   800	                    TimelineEntry(
   801	                        entry_type=TimelineEntryType.TOOL_CALL,
   802	                        content="",  # Content is empty for native tool calls
   803	                        tool_calls=tool_calls,  # Store native tool_calls array
   804	                    )
   805	                )
   806	            else:
   807	                # Legacy XML format - store each tool call separately
   808	                for tool_call in tool_calls:
   809	                    timeline.add_entry(
   810	                        TimelineEntry(
   811	                            entry_type=TimelineEntryType.TOOL_CALL,
   812	                            content=self._format_tool_call_as_xml(tool_call),
   813	                        )
   814	                    )
   815	
   816	        # Output parameter checking
   817	        response = response or ""
   818	        assert isinstance(response, str)
   819	        assert isinstance(tool_calls, list)
   820	        trace_percepts |= {
   821	            "response": response,
   822	            "reasoning": reasoning,
   823	            "tool_calls": tool_calls,
   824	            "done": done,
   825	            "todo_list": todo_list,
   826	        }
   827	
   828	        if output_state == "exit":
   829	            trace_percepts = self._mark_star_loop_exit(trace_percepts)
   830	
   831	        return super()._think(trace_percepts)

   833	    @observable
   834	    def _act(self, trace_thoughts: DictParams) -> DictParams:
   835	        """
   836	        ACT: Execute tool calls and return results.
   837	        TODO: this is a good place to send interactive feedback to the user before making tool calls
   838	
   839	        Args:
   840	            trace_thoughts (DictParams): the thoughts produced by this THINK phase.
   841	              - response (str): Response from the LLM from the THINK phase.
   842	              - tool_calls (list[DictParams]): Tool calls from the THINK phase.
   843	              - caller_message (str): Caller message (may be user or another agent)
   844	              - caller_type (str): Type of caller (agent or human)
   845	              - caller_id (str): ID of the caller (agent.object_id or user) for conversation tracking.
   846	
   847	        Returns:
   848	            - trace_outputs (DictParams): the outputs produced by this ACT phase.
   849	              - response (str): Response from the LLM from the THINK phase.
   850	              - tool_calls (list[DictParams]): Tool calls from the THINK phase.
   851	              - tool_results: list[DictParams]: Tool results from the ACT phase if there are tool calls
   852	              - caller_message (str): Caller message (may be user or another agent)
   853	              - caller_type (str): Type of caller (agent or human)
   854	              - caller_id (str): ID of the caller (agent.object_id or user) for conversation tracking.
   855	        """
   856	
   857	        # Input parameter checking
   858	        trace_thoughts = trace_thoughts or {}
   859	        if not trace_thoughts or self._do_exit_star_loop(trace_thoughts):
   860	            return {"trace_outputs": self._mark_star_loop_exit(trace_thoughts)}
   861	
   862	        tool_calls: list[DictParams] = trace_thoughts.get("tool_calls")
   863	
   864	        # Execute tool calls using runtime
   865	        tool_results = self._runtime.execute_tools(self, tool_calls)
   866	
   867	        # Add tool results to timeline
   868	        if isinstance(tool_results, list):
   869	            for tool_result in tool_results:
   870	                if isinstance(tool_result, dict):
   871	                    # Determine entry type based on tool type
   872	                    tool_type = tool_result.get("type")
   873	                    if tool_type == "agent":
   874	                        entry_type = TimelineEntryType.SUB_AGENT_RESPONSE
   875	                    elif tool_type == "resource":
   876	                        entry_type = TimelineEntryType.RESOURCE_RESULT
   877	                    elif tool_type == "workflow":
   878	                        entry_type = TimelineEntryType.WORKFLOW_RESULT
   879	                    else:  # unknown
   880	                        entry_type = TimelineEntryType.UNKNOWN_TOOL_CALL
   881	
   882	                    # Ensure content is a string (tool results may be dicts)
   883	                    result_content = tool_result.get("result", "Unknown tool result")
   884	                    if not isinstance(result_content, str):
   885	                        import json
   886	
   887	                        result_content = json.dumps(result_content)
   888	
   889	                    # Include tool_call_id for OpenAI native tool support
   890	                    self._timeline.add_entry(
   891	                        TimelineEntry(
   892	                            entry_type=entry_type,
   893	                            content=result_content,
   894	                            tool_call_id=tool_result.get("tool_call_id"),
   895	                        )
   896	                    )
   897	
   898	            # Add a system reminder to continue if task is not complete
   899	            # Find original user request
   900	            original_request = ""
   901	            for entry in self._timeline.timeline:
   902	                if entry.entry_type == TimelineEntryType.USER_MESSAGE:
   903	                    original_request = entry.content
   904	                    break
   905	
   906	            # Count completed tool calls to estimate progress
   907	            tool_call_count = sum(1 for entry in self._timeline.timeline if entry.entry_type == TimelineEntryType.TOOL_CALL)
   908	
   909	            # Estimate expected steps based on sequential action patterns
   910	            # "search then fetch" = 2 steps, "search, then process, then save" = 3 steps
   911	            request_lower = original_request.lower()
   912	            # Count occurrences of step separators (avoiding overlap)
   913	            import re
   914	
   915	            step_separators = re.findall(r"\bthen\b|\bafter that\b|\bnext\b|\bfinally\b", request_lower)
   916	            expected_steps = 1 + len(step_separators)
   917	            # Cap expected_steps at a reasonable maximum
   918	            expected_steps = min(expected_steps, 5)
   919	
   920	            # Only add reminder if we haven't completed all expected steps
   921	            if tool_call_count < expected_steps:
   922	                remaining = expected_steps - tool_call_count
   923	                self._timeline.add_entry(
   924	                    TimelineEntry(
   925	                        entry_type=TimelineEntryType.AGENT_THOUGHTS,
   926	                        content=f"[MULTI-STEP TASK - {remaining} STEP(S) REMAINING] "
   927	                        f"Completed {tool_call_count}/{expected_steps} steps. "
   928	                        "I MUST call the next tool using this EXACT XML format: "
   929	                        '<function_call><invoke name="resource-id:method"><parameter name="param">value</parameter></invoke></function_call>',
   930	                    )
   931	                )
   932	
   933	        # Output parameter checking
   934	        assert isinstance(tool_results, list)
   935	        trace_thoughts |= {"tool_results": tool_results}
   936	
   937	        return super()._act(trace_thoughts)

   940	    def _reflect(self, trace_outputs: DictParams) -> DictParams:
   941	        """
   942	        REFLECT: Reflect on the actions or episode, depending on the reflection phase.
   943	
   944	        Args:
   945	            trace_outputs (DictParams): the outputs produced by this ACT phase.
   946	              - phase (LearningPhase): specifies which learning phase we are in
   947	              - response (str): Response from the THINK phase.
   948	              - tool_calls (list[DictParams]): Tool calls from the THINK phase.
   949	              - tool_results (list[DictParams]): Tool results from the ACT phase.
   950	              - caller_message (str): Caller message (may be user or another agent)
   951	              - caller_type (str): Type of caller (agent or human)
   952	              - caller_id (str): ID of the caller (agent.object_id or user) for conversation tracking.
   953	
   954	        Returns:
   955	            - trace_learning (DictParams): the learning produced by this REFLECT phase.
   956	        """
   957	
   958	        # Input parameter checking
   959	        trace_outputs = trace_outputs or {}
   960	        if not trace_outputs or self._do_exit_star_loop(trace_outputs):
   961	            return {"trace_learning": self._mark_star_loop_exit(trace_outputs)}
   962	        phase: LearningPhase = trace_outputs.get("phase") or LearningPhase.ACQUISITIVE
   963	
   964	        trace_learning = {}
   965	        if self._learner is not None:
   966	            match phase:
   967	                case LearningPhase.ACQUISITIVE:
   968	                    trace_learning |= self._learner._reflect_acquisitive(trace_outputs)
   969	                    trace_learning["learning_note"] = "Initial learning and trial-level plasticity"
   970	
   971	                case LearningPhase.EPISODIC:
   972	                    trace_learning |= self._learner._reflect_episodic(trace_outputs)
   973	                    trace_learning["learning_note"] = "Episodic binding of information"
   974	
   975	                case LearningPhase.INTEGRATIVE:
   976	                    trace_learning |= self._learner._reflect_integrative(trace_outputs)
   977	                    trace_learning["learning_note"] = "Offline replay and integration"
   978	
   979	                case LearningPhase.RETENTIVE:
   980	                    trace_learning |= self._learner._reflect_retentive(trace_outputs)
   981	                    trace_learning["learning_note"] = "Long-term maintenance and habit formation"
   982	
   983	                case _:
   984	                    raise ValueError(f"Unknown learning phase {phase}")
   985	
   986	            trace_learning |= {
   987	                "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
   988	                "phase": phase.value,
   989	            }
   990	
   991	            # Add to timeline for persistence
   992	            self._timeline.add_entry(
   993	                TimelineEntry(
   994	                    entry_type=TimelineEntryType.AGENT_LEARNING,
   995	                    content=f"Learning ({phase.value}): {trace_learning.get('learning_note', 'No learning note')}",
   996	                )
   997	            )
   998	
   999	        return super()._reflect(trace_learning)

   355	    @observable
   356	    def parse_response(self, raw: str | dict | Any) -> ParsedResponse:
   357	        if raw is None:
   358	            return ParsedResponse(done=None, reasoning=None, response=None, tool_calls=[], todo_list=None)
   359	
   360	        # Ensure raw is a string - LLM providers sometimes return unexpected types
   361	        if not isinstance(raw, str):
   362	            raw = str(raw)
   363	
   364	        content = raw.strip()
   365	        done = None
   366	        response_text = None
   367	        tool_calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
   368	        todo_list: list[TodoItem] | None = None
   369	        reasoning = None
   370	
   371	        # Check for native tool calls from the LLM response
   372	        has_native_tool_calls = False
   373	        if self._last_llm_response and self._last_llm_response.tool_calls:
   374	            tool_calls.extend(self._to_tool_call_dicts(self._last_llm_response.tool_calls))
   375	            has_native_tool_calls = True
   376	
   377	        # Parse JSON from content
   378	        if content:
   379	            parsed_json = self._extract_json(content)
   380	            if parsed_json:
   381	                reasoning = parsed_json.get("reasoning")
   382	                json_todo_list = parsed_json.get("todo_list", [])
   383	                if json_todo_list:
   384	                    todo_list = []
   385	                    for item in json_todo_list:
   386	                        if isinstance(item, dict):
   387	                            todo_list.append(
   388	                                TodoItem(
   389	                                    content=item.get("content", ""),
   390	                                    status=item.get("status", "pending"),
   391	                                )
   392	                            )
   393	                done = parsed_json.get("done")
   394	                # Accept both "response" and "message" as valid field names
   395	                response_text = parsed_json.get("response") or parsed_json.get("message")
   396	
   397	                # Ensure response_text is a string (LLM might return nested dict)
   398	                if response_text is not None and not isinstance(response_text, str):
   399	                    response_text = str(response_text)
   400	
   401	                # Handle case where response text comes after a minimal JSON object
   402	                # e.g., '{"done":true} Here is the actual response...'
   403	                if not response_text and done is True:
   404	                    # Find where the JSON ends and extract trailing text as response
   405	                    trailing_text = self._extract_trailing_text(content)
   406	                    if trailing_text:
   407	                        response_text = trailing_text
   408	
   409	                # Only extract tool_calls from JSON if not using native tools
   410	                if not self._native_tools:
   411	                    json_tool_calls = parsed_json.get("tool_calls", [])
   412	                    if json_tool_calls:
   413	                        for tc in json_tool_calls:
   414	                            name = tc.get("name", "")
   415	                            params = tc.get("parameters", {})
   416	                            tool_calls.append({"function": name, "arguments": params})
   417	            elif not has_native_tool_calls:
   418	                if not self._native_tools:
   419	                    logger.warning(
   420	                        "Failed to parse JSON from LLM response", content_preview=content[:500] if len(content) > 500 else content
   421	                    )
   422	
   423	        # Native tool calls override done flag
   424	        if has_native_tool_calls:
   425	            done = False
   426	
   427	        return ParsedResponse(
   428	            done=done,
   429	            reasoning=reasoning,
   430	            response=response_text if response_text else None,
   431	            tool_calls=tool_calls,
   432	            todo_list=todo_list,
   433	        )

   495	        if self._llm is not None:

   506	    def _get_runtime_context(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
   507	        """Get runtime context info for the current query."""
   508	        fields = self.get_runtime_context_fields()
   509	        context = {}
   510	
   511	        now = datetime.now().astimezone()
   512	        if "timestamp" in fields:
   513	            context["timestamp"] = now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
   514	        if "timezone" in fields:

   516	        if "user" in fields:

   525	    def _get_ip_location(self) -> str | None:
   526	        """Get location from IP geolocation (cached)."""
   527	        if AgentRuntime._cached_location is not None:

   529	
   530	        try:
   531	            import urllib.request
   532	
   533	            with urllib.request.urlopen("http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=city,regionName,country", timeout=2) as response:
   534	                data = json.loads(response.read().decode())
   535	                if data.get("city"):
   536	                    location = f"{data.get('city', '')}, {data.get('regionName', '')}, {data.get('country', '')}"
   537	                    AgentRuntime._cached_location = {"location": location}
   538	                    return location
   539	        except Exception:

   541

   579	    def _build_tool_name_registry(self, agent) -> None:
   580	        """Build mapping from custom tool names to (object, method_name).
   581	
   582	        This registry enables execution of tools decorated with @named_tool
   583	        by mapping their custom names back to the actual objects and methods.
   584	        """
   585	        self._tool_name_registry.clear()
   586	
   587	        # Register resources
   588	        for resource in getattr(agent, "_resources", []):
   589	            for method_name, method in Misc.extract_tool_use_methods(resource):
   590	                sig = Misc.parse_method_signature(method, object_id=getattr(resource, "object_id", None))
   591	                if sig.tool_name:
   592	                    self._tool_name_registry[sig.tool_name] = (resource, method_name)
   593	
   594	        # Register workflows
   595	        for workflow in getattr(agent, "_workflows", []):
   596	            if hasattr(workflow, "execute"):
   597	                sig = Misc.parse_method_signature(workflow.execute, object_id=getattr(workflow, "object_id", None))
   598	                if sig.tool_name:
   599	                    self._tool_name_registry[sig.tool_name] = (workflow, "execute")
   600	
   601	        # Register sub-agents (they expose query method)
   602	        for sub_agent in getattr(agent, "_agents", []):
   603	            if hasattr(sub_agent, "query"):
   604	                sig = Misc.parse_method_signature(sub_agent.query, object_id=getattr(sub_agent, "agent_type", None))

   682	    def _extract_json(self, content: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
   683	        """Extract JSON object from content."""
   684	        if not content:
   685	            return None
   686	
   687	        try:
   688	            return json.loads(content.strip())
   689	        except json.JSONDecodeError:
   690	            pass
   691	
   692	        # Try markdown code block
   693	        json_match = re.search(r"```(?:json)?\s*(\{.+\})\s*```", content, re.DOTALL)
   694	        if json_match:
   695	            try:
   696	                return json.loads(json_match.group(1))
   697	            except json.JSONDecodeError:
   698	                pass
   699	
   700	        # Try balanced brace matching
   701	        start_idx = content.find('{"done"')
   702	        if start_idx == -1:
   703	            start_idx = content.find("{\n")
   704	        if start_idx == -1:
   705	            start_idx = content.find("{")
   706	
   707	        if start_idx != -1:
   708	            depth = 0
   709	            for i, char in enumerate(content[start_idx:], start_idx):
   710	                if char == "{":
   711	                    depth += 1
   712	                elif char == "}":
   713	                    depth -= 1
   714	                    if depth == 0:
   715	                        try:
   716	                            return json.loads(content[start_idx : i + 1])
   717	                        except json.JSONDecodeError:
   718	                            pass
   719	                        break
   720	
   721	        return None
   722	
   723	    def _extract_trailing_text(self, content: str) -> str | None:
   724	        """Extract text that comes after a JSON object.
   725	
   726	        Handles cases like: '{"done":true} Here is the actual response...'
   727	        Returns the trailing text after the JSON object, or None if no trailing text.
   728	        """
   729	        if not content:
   730	            return None
   731	
   732	        # Find the JSON object boundaries
   733	        start_idx = content.find("{")
   734	        if start_idx == -1:
   735	            return None
   736	
   737	        depth = 0
   738	        end_idx = -1
   739	        for i, char in enumerate(content[start_idx:], start_idx):
   740	            if char == "{":
   741	                depth += 1
   742	            elif char == "}":
   743	                depth -= 1
   744	                if depth == 0:
   745	                    end_idx = i
   746	                    break
   747	
   748	        if end_idx == -1:
   749	            return None
   750	
   751	        # Extract text after the JSON object
   752	        trailing = content[end_idx + 1 :].strip()
   753	        if trailing:
   754	            return trailing
   755	
   756	        return None
   757	
   758	    def _extract_content_between_xml_tags(self, content: str, tag: str) -> str | None:
   759	        if not content or not tag:
   760	            return None
   761	
   762	        escaped_tag = re.escape(tag)
   763	        match = re.search(r"<" + escaped_tag + r">(.*?)</" + escaped_tag + r">", content, re.DOTALL)
   764	        if match:
   765	            return match.group(1).strip()
   766	
   767	        match = re.search(r"<" + escaped_tag + r">([^<]*)", content, re.DOTALL)
   768	        if match:
   769	            captured = match.group(1).strip()
   770	            if not captured:
   771	                match = re.search(r"<" + escaped_tag + r">(.*)", content, re.DOTALL)
   772	                if match:
   773	                    return match.group(1).strip()
   774	            return captured
   775	
   776	        return None

   778	    def _to_tool_call_dicts(self, llm_tool_calls: list) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
   779	        tool_call_dicts = []
   780	        for llm_tool_call in llm_tool_calls:
   781	            try:
   782	                tool_call_id = getattr(llm_tool_call, "id", None)
   783	                function_name = llm_tool_call.function.name
   784	                arguments = llm_tool_call.function.arguments
   785	                if isinstance(arguments, str):
   786	                    arguments = json.loads(arguments) if arguments else {}
   787	                call_dict = {"function": function_name, "arguments": arguments}
   788	                if tool_call_id:
   789	                    call_dict["tool_call_id"] = tool_call_id
   790	                tool_call_dicts.append(call_dict)
   791	            except Exception:
   792	                continue
   793	        return tool_call_dicts

   811	    def _find_object_by_id(self, object_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
   812	        for agent in self._agent.available_agents:
   813	            if (hasattr(agent, "object_id") and agent.object_id == object_id) or (
   814	                hasattr(agent, "agent_type") and agent.agent_type == object_id
   815	            ):
   816	                return {"type": "agent", "object": agent}
   817	
   818	        for resource in self._agent.available_resources:
   819	            if (hasattr(resource, "object_id") and resource.object_id == object_id) or (
   820	                hasattr(resource, "resource_id") and resource.resource_id == object_id
   821	            ):
   822	                return {"type": "resource", "object": resource}
   823	
   824	        for workflow in self._agent.available_workflows:
   825	            if (hasattr(workflow, "object_id") and workflow.object_id == object_id) or (
   826	                hasattr(workflow, "workflow_id") and workflow.workflow_id == object_id
   827	            ):
   828	                return {"type": "workflow", "object": workflow}
   829	
   830	        self._agent.ensure_registered()
   831	        registry = self._agent._registry
   832	        if registry and object_id in registry._items:
   833	            agent = registry.get(object_id)
   834	            if agent:
   835	                return {"type": "agent", "object": agent}
   836
