    20	class RuntimeRegistry:
    21	    """
    22	    Registry for selecting the appropriate AgentRuntime based on conditions.
    23	
    24	    This class manages runtime registrations and selection logic.
    25	    Use the class-level `default` instance for standard usage, or create
    26	    custom instances for specialized scenarios.
    27	
    28	    Usage:
    29	        # Use the default registry
    30	        runtime = RuntimeRegistry.select_runtime(provider="anthropic", model="claude-3")
    31	
    32	        # Register a custom runtime
    33	        RuntimeRegistry.get_default().register(
    34	            MyCustomRuntime,
    35	            provider="custom-provider",
    36	            priority=20,
    37	        )
    38	
    39	        # Create a custom registry
    40	        custom_registry = RuntimeRegistry()
    41	        custom_registry.register(SpecialRuntime, model_pattern="special-*")
    42	    """
    43	
    44	    # Class-level default instance (lazily initialized)
    45	    _default: RuntimeRegistry | None = None
    46	
    47	    def __init__(self) -> None:
    48	        self._rules: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], type[AgentRuntime], dict[str, Any]]] = []
    49	
    50	    @classmethod
    51	    def get_default(cls) -> RuntimeRegistry:
    52	        """Get the default registry with standard runtime registrations."""
    53	        if cls._default is None:
    54	            cls._default = cls._create_default()
    55	        return cls._default
    56	
    57	    @classmethod
    58	    def _create_default(cls) -> RuntimeRegistry:
    59	        """Create the default registry with standard runtime registrations."""
    60	        from .anthropic import AnthropicRuntime
    61	        from .default import DefaultRuntime
    62	        from .openai import OpenAIRuntime
    63	
    64	        registry = cls()
    65	
    66	        # Register provider-specific runtimes with higher priority
    67	        registry.register(AnthropicRuntime, provider="anthropic", priority=10)
    68	        registry.register(OpenAIRuntime, provider="openai", priority=10)
    69	
    70	        # Register DefaultRuntime as the fallback for all other providers
    71	        registry.register(DefaultRuntime, priority=0)
    72	
    73	        return registry

    75	    @classmethod
    76	    def select_runtime(
    77	        cls,

    79	        provider: str = "anthropic",

    81	    ) -> AgentRuntime:
    82	        """
    83	        Select the appropriate runtime using the default registry.

    87	        Args:

   134	    @classmethod
   135	    def reset_default(cls) -> None:
   136	        """Reset the default registry. Useful for testing."""
   137	        cls._default = None

   139	    def register(
   140	        self,
   141	        runtime_class: type[AgentRuntime],
   142	        *,
   143	        provider: str | list[str] | None = None,
   144	        model_pattern: str | None = None,
   145	        priority: int = 0,
   146	        **default_kwargs: Any,
   147	    ) -> RuntimeRegistry:
   148	        """
   149	        Register a runtime class with matching conditions.
   150	
   151	        Args:
   152	            runtime_class: The AgentRuntime class to instantiate when conditions match.
   153	            provider: Match specific provider(s). None matches any provider.
   154	            model_pattern: Glob pattern for model names (e.g., "claude-3*", "gpt-4*").
   155	            priority: Higher priority rules are checked first. Default is 0.
   156	            **default_kwargs: Default kwargs passed to the runtime constructor.
   157	
   158	        Returns:
   159	            self, for chaining.
   160	        """
   161	        conditions = {
   162	            "provider": provider,
   163	            "model_pattern": model_pattern,
   164	            "priority": priority,
   165	        }
   166	        self._rules.append((conditions, runtime_class, default_kwargs))
   167	        # Sort by priority (higher first)
   168	        self._rules.sort(key=lambda x: -x[0].get("priority", 0))
   169	        return self

   171	    def select(
   172	        self,
   173	        model: str | None = None,
   174	        provider: str = "anthropic",
   175	        **kwargs: Any,
   176	    ) -> AgentRuntime:
   177	        """
   178	        Select and instantiate the appropriate runtime.
   179	
   180	        Args:
   181	            model: The model name (e.g., "claude-3-opus-20240229").
   182	            provider: The provider name (e.g., "anthropic", "openai").
   183	            **kwargs: Additional kwargs passed to the runtime constructor.
   184	
   185	        Returns:
   186	            An instantiated AgentRuntime.
   187	        """
   188	        for conditions, runtime_class, default_kwargs in self._rules:
   189	            if self._matches(conditions, model, provider):
   190	                merged_kwargs = {**default_kwargs, **kwargs}
   191	                return runtime_class(model=model, provider=provider, **merged_kwargs)
   192	
   193	        # Fallback to DefaultRuntime
   194	        from .default import DefaultRuntime
   195	
   196	        return DefaultRuntime(model=model, provider=provider, **kwargs)

   198	    def _matches(
   199	        self,
   200	        conditions: dict[str, Any],
   201	        model: str | None,
   202	        provider: str,
   203	    ) -> bool:
   204	        """Check if conditions match the given model and provider."""
   205	        # Check provider
   206	        cond_provider = conditions.get("provider")
   207	        if cond_provider is not None:
   208	            if isinstance(cond_provider, list):
   209	                if provider not in cond_provider:
   210	                    return False
   211	            elif provider != cond_provider:
   212	                return False
   213	
   214	        # Check model pattern
   215	        model_pattern = conditions.get("model_pattern")
   216	        if model_pattern is not None:
   217	            if model is None:
   218	                return False
   219	            if not fnmatch.fnmatch(model, model_pattern):
   220	                return False
   221	
   222	        return True

Here’s a concise map of what STARAgent is, how it plugs into the runtime, and where it’s used.

What STARAgent is
- Main See-Think-Act-Reflect agent used across the repo, composition-based over BaseSTARAgent: dana_agent/dana/core/agent/star_agent.py:43
- Defaults provider if none is given via config_manager, falling back to "anthropic": dana_agent/dana/core/agent/star_agent.py:114-116
- Constructor accepts either a concrete runtime or auto-selects one; legacy codec path is deprecated: dana_agent/dana/core/agent/star_agent.py:95-103,131-172

How STARAgent integrates with the runtime
- Runtime selection in __init__:
  - codec is None → LegacyRuntime (deprecated, warns): dana_agent/dana/core/agent/star_agent.py:131-144
  - codec is default sentinel → RuntimeRegistry.select_runtime(provider, model): dana_agent/dana/core/agent/star_agent.py:145-154
  - codec is a subclass of AbstractCodec → RuntimeRegistry.select_codec_runtime(...), with deprecation warning: dana_agent/dana/core/agent/star_agent.py:155-165
  - If runtime param is provided, it’s used directly; codec is ignored (warns): dana_agent/dana/core/agent/star_agent.py:165-172
- Runtime registry and provider mappings:
  - AnthropicRuntime and OpenAIRuntime registered with priority; DefaultRuntime as fallback: dana_agent/dana/core/runtime/selector.py:66-71
  - select_runtime / select_codec_runtime entrypoints: dana_agent/dana/core/runtime/selector.py:75-96,98-132
  - Registry select() logic and fallback to DefaultRuntime: dana_agent/dana/core/runtime/selector.py:171-196
- How STARAgent uses runtime hooks in the STAR loop:
  - THINK builds messages via runtime.build_prompt, calls LLM, parses output, validates “done” vs tools/response:
    - build_prompt, call_llm, parse_response: dana_agent/dana/core/agent/star_agent.py:701-709
    - validate_done_output decision: dana_agent/dana/core/agent/star_agent.py:717-721
  - ACT executes tools via runtime.execute_tools (also stores results on timeline): dana_agent/dana/core/agent/star_agent.py:864-866
  - Async paths use call_llm_async / execute_tools_async when available: dana_agent/dana/core/agent/star_agent.py:1032-1043,1201-1208
- When you add agents/resources/workflows, STARAgent resets the runtime (so it can rebuild tool schemas/prompts): dana_agent/dana/core/agent/star_agent.py:308-317,320-325
- LLM client handoff: if agent.llm_client is set, STARAgent forwards to runtime via set_llm: dana_agent/dana/core/agent/star_agent.py:295-301
